hooks.command: F=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.file_path // .tool_input.file_path // empty'); echo "$F" | grep -qE '\.env|/migrations/' && [ -z "$ALLOW_SENSITIVE" ] && { echo 'Blocked: .env/migrations need ALLOW_SENSITIVE=1 (wt-db only)' >&2; exit 2; } || exit 0
echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE 'DROP TABLE|TRUNCATE|service_role' && { echo 'Blocked dangerous command' >&2; exit 2; } || exit 0

INPUT=$(cat); [ "$(echo $INPUT | jq -r '.stop_hook_active')" = 'true' ] && exit 0; pnpm turbo run typecheck test --filter="...[origin/main]" || { echo 'Gates failing — fix before stopping' >&2; exit 2; }
